css.context: .priorityPill.mine{color:#f4fbff;border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--deck-a,#52b8ff) 78%,#fff);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--deck-a,#52b8ff) 12%,rgba(4,10,14,.84));box-shadow:0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb,var(--deck-a,#52b8ff) 18%,transparent),0 0 22px color-mix(in srgb,var(--deck-glow,rgba(82,184,255,.2)) 62%,transparent)}

/* Phase 81 — Assist Mode confidence/action layer. Private and read-only. */
.assistCoach{margin:8px 0 2px;border:1px solid #2a485d;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(12,30,42,.94),rgba(7,18,26,.94));border-radius:11px;padding:9px 10px;box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(82,184,255,.07)}

/* Phase 73 — Smart Priority UX hardening */
.priorityDirector{position:relative;margin-top:8px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--deck-a) 30%,#273f50);border-radius:11px;padding:8px 9px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--deck-a) 7%,#071018),color-mix(in srgb,var(--deck-b) 5%,#061018));overflow:hidden}

js.name: priorityOpen
js.body: function priorityOpen(startPlayerId,reason='priority-window',sourceStackId=null,meta={source:'smart-priority'}){if(!HST||typeof MTGSmartPriority==='undefined')return null;let priorityActor=Number(startPlayerId||st.active||me),sba=applyStateBasedFixedPoint(priorityActor,{...meta,source:'priority-sba'});if(hasPendingCommanderZoneChoice()){if(sba.candidates?.length)pendingPriorityTriggerCandidates.push(...sba.candidates);resolutionCheckpointPending=false;let q=pendingCommanderZoneChoices()[0];setR('COMMANDER CHOICE',(q?.name||'Commander')+' · Player '+Number(q?.ownerId||0)+' must choose whether to move it to the command zone.');send({t:'state',st});if(soloTestMode)scheduleSoloNpc(250);return null}let waiting=[...pendingPriorityTriggerCandidates,...sba.candidates].filter(c=>!st.fallen?.[Number(c?.item?.controllerId??c?.controllerId)]);pendingPriorityTriggerCandidates=[];if(waiting.length)queueTriggerCandidates(waiting,'PRIORITY_CHECKPOINT',{resumePriorityPlayerId:priorityActor});resolutionCheckpointPending=false;if(rulesProgressionBlocked())return null;if(waiting.length&&(st.stack||[]).length){reason='state-based-trigger-response';sourceStackId=st.stack.at(-1)?.id||sourceStackId}let flow=MTGSmartPriority.open(st,players,{mode:smartPriorityMode(),startPlayerId:priorityActor,reason,sourceStackId});emit('PRIORITY_WINDOW_OPENED',{flow},priorityActor,meta);send({t:'state',st});if(soloTestMode)scheduleSoloNpc(250);return flow}function priorityClose(reason='priority-complete',meta={source:'smart-priority'}){if(!HST)return;emit('PRIORITY_WINDOW_CLOSED',{reason},me,meta);send({t:'state',st})}function priorityRespond(id,meta={source:'smart-priority'}){if(!HST||typeof MTGSmartPriority==='undefined')return false;if(st.replacementOrderPending){if(Number(id)===Number(me))showReplacementOrderPrompt()||toast('Complete the replacement-order choice first.');return false}id=Number(id);let view=MTGSmartPriority.view(st,players,id);if(!view.hasWindow){if((st.stack||[]).length){priorityOpen(st.active,'stack-response',st.stack.at(-1)?.id,meta);view=MTGSmartPriority.view(st,players,id)}else if(typeof MTGTurnStructure!=='undefined'&&!MTGTurnStructure.allowsPriority(st.phase)){setR('TURN STEP',String(st.phase)+' · no normal priority.');if(id===me)toast('No normal priority during '+String(st.phase)+'.');return false}else if(smartPriorityMode()==='relaxed'){priorityOpen(id,'casual-response',null,meta);view=MTGSmartPriority.view(st,players,id)}else{priorityOpen(st.active,'table-priority',null,meta);view=MTGSmartPriority.view(st,players,id)}}if(view.isHolder){let held={...view.flow,responseHeldBy:id};emit('PRIORITY_CLAIMED',{flow:held,impliedPasses:[],holdOnly:true},id,meta);send({t:'state',st});setR('HELD','Player '+id+' is responding.');MTGAnnouncerEngine.event('priorityResponse',{playerId:id});return true}if(smartPriorityMode()==='relaxed'){let plan=MTGSmartPriority.claim(st,players,id);if(plan.ok){emit('PRIORITY_CLAIMED',{flow:plan.flow,impliedPasses:plan.impliedPasses},id,meta);send({t:'state',st});setR('HELD','Player '+id+' claimed the casual response window.');MTGAnnouncerEngine.event('priorityResponse',{playerId:id});return true}if(plan.reason==='holder-responding'){setR('HELD','Player '+plan.expected+' is already responding.');if(id===me)toast('Player '+plan.expected+' is already responding.');return false}}setR('PRIORITY','Waiting for Player '+(st.priorityFlow?.holder||st.priority||st.active)+'.');if(id===me)toast('Priority is with Player '+(st.priorityFlow?.holder||st.priority||st.active)+'.');return false}function priorityPass(id,meta={source:'smart-priority'}){if(!HST||typeof MTGSmartPriority==='undefined')return false;if(st.replacementOrderPending){if(Number(id)===Number(me))showReplacementOrderPrompt()||toast('Complete the replacement-order choice first.');return false}id=Number(id);if(!st.priorityFlow?.windowId||st.priorityFlow?.complete){if((st.stack||[]).length)priorityOpen(st.active,'stack-response',st.stack.at(-1)?.id,meta);else if(typeof MTGTurnStructure!=='undefined'&&!MTGTurnStructure.allowsPriority(st.phase))return authoritativeRulesPump(meta);else priorityOpen(st.active,'phase-priority',null,meta)}let plan=MTGSmartPriority.pass(st,players,id);if(!plan.ok){if(id===me)toast(plan.reason==='not-priority-holder'?'Priority is with Player '+plan.expected+'.':'No priority pass is available.');return false}emit('PRIORITY_PASSED',{flow:plan.flow,playerId:id,allPassed:plan.allPassed},id,meta);send({t:'state',st});if(!plan.allPassed){setR('PRIORITY','Priority passed to Player '+plan.flow.holder+'.');continueAutomaticPriorityYield();if(soloTestMode)scheduleSoloNpc(250);return true}setR('PASSED','All players passed.');if(st.stack.length){resolveTop({fromPriority:true});return true}if(typeof MTGCleanupLoop!=='undefined'&&MTGCleanupLoop.shouldRepeat(st)){priorityClose('cleanup-exception-cleared',{source:'cleanup-loop'});startRepeatedCleanup();return true}priorityClose('empty-stack-pass-cycle',{source:'rules-kernel'});return authoritativeAdvanceRulesNode({source:'rules-kernel'},{reason:'all-pass-empty'})}function priorityActionAllowed(id){if(hasPendingCommanderZoneChoice()){if(Number(id)===Number(me))toast('Complete the pending commander command-zone choice first.');return false}if(st.advancedResolutionPending){if(Number(id)===Number(me))toast('Complete the pending advanced-resolution choice first.');return false}if(st.replacementOrderPending){if(Number(id)===Number(me))toast('Choose the replacement/prevention order first.');return false}if(st.oracleChoicePending){if(Number(id)===Number(me))toast('Complete the pending card choice first.');return false}if(st.triggerOrderPending&&!st.triggerOrderPending.deferredUntil){if(Number(id)===Number(me))toast('Order simultaneous triggers first.');return false}if(typeof MTGSmartPriority==='undefined')return true;let check=MTGSmartPriority.actionAllowed(st,players,id,{stackSensitive:true});if(check.ok&&check.reason.includes('relaxed')&&st.priorityFlow?.windowId&&!st.priorityFlow.complete&&Number(st.priorityFlow.holder)!==Number(id))priorityRespond(id,{source:'casual-action-shortcut'});return check.ok}function priorityIntentMeta(kind){if(typeof MTGSmartPriority==='undefined')return{};let i=MTGSmartPriority.intent(st,me,kind);return{priorityWindowId:i.windowId,priorityOpenedAtSeq:i.openedAtSeq}}function respondQuick(){setR('HELD','Player '+me+' wants to respond.');if(HST){priorityRespond(me,{source:'host-ui'})}else if(cc?.open)cc.send({t:'respond',requestId:requestId(),clientId,...priorityIntentMeta('respond')});else toast('Reconnecting…')} function passQuick(){if(st.advancedResolutionPending)return maybePromptAdvancedResolution()||maybePromptCastingCost()||maybePromptOracleChoice()||toast('Waiting for an advanced-resolution choice.');if(st.replacementOrderPending)return showReplacementOrderPrompt()||toast('Waiting for a replacement-order choice.');if(st.oracleChoicePending)return showOracleChoicePrompt()||toast('Waiting for a required card choice.');if(st.triggerOrderPending&&!st.triggerOrderPending.deferredUntil)return showTriggerOrderPrompt()||toast('Waiting for trigger ordering.');if(HST){priorityPass(me,{source:'host-ui'})}else if(cc?.open)cc.send({t:'pass',requestId:requestId(),clientId,...priorityIntentMeta('pass')});else toast('Reconnecting…')}

js.name: renderPlayerAlerts
js.body: function renderPlayerAlerts(){if(typeof MTGPlayerAlerts==='undefined'||!$('game'))return;let hud=document.querySelector('.playerHud'),banner=$('hudCriticalBanner');if(!hud||!banner)return;if(!hudFlags.criticalStateAwareness){hud.removeAttribute('data-life-band');hud.removeAttribute('data-poison-band');hud.removeAttribute('data-commander-band');hud.classList.remove('lastStandHud','criticalHud');banner.className='hudCriticalBanner h';banner.textContent='';lastPlayerAlertStatus=null;return}let matchId=st.meta?.matchId||'local';if(lastPlayerAlertMatchId!==matchId){lastPlayerAlertStatus=null;lastPlayerAlertMatchId=matchId}let current=MTGPlayerAlerts.evaluate(st,me),changes=MTGPlayerAlerts.transition(lastPlayerAlertStatus,current);hud.dataset.lifeBand=current.lifeBand;hud.dataset.poisonBand=current.poisonBand;hud.dataset.commanderBand=current.commanderBand;hud.classList.toggle('lastStandHud',current.lastStand);hud.classList.toggle('criticalHud',current.critical);let label='',detail='';if(current.lastStand){label='LAST STAND';detail=current.reasons.map(x=>x.label).join(' · ')}else if(current.poison>=8){label='POISON DANGER';detail=current.poison+' / 10'}else if(current.commanderDamage>=18){label='COMMANDER DAMAGE';detail=current.commanderDamage+' / 21 · '+current.commanderRemaining+' REMAINING'}else if(current.life<=10){label='LOW LIFE';detail=current.life+' LIFE'}if(label){banner.classList.remove('h');banner.innerHTML=''+esc(label)+''+esc(detail)+''}else{banner.classList.add('h');banner.textContent=''}if(changes.length){banner.classList.remove('attentionPulse');void banner.offsetWidth;banner.classList.add('attentionPulse');let top=changes[0];if(top.id==='last-stand')toast('LAST STAND · '+top.detail);else if(top.id==='recovered')toast('SECOND WIND')}lastPlayerAlertStatus=current}

js.name: renderAssistCoach
js.body:
function renderAssistCoach(){let mount=$('assistCoach');if(!mount||typeof MTGAssistMode==='undefined')return;let v=MTGAssistMode.evaluate({enabled:assistEnabled(),state:st,players,playerId:me,profile:prof,dismissedKeys:Object.keys(assistHistory.dismissed||{}),seenKeys:Object.keys(assistHistory.seen||{})});mount.classList.toggle('h',!v.show);if(!v.show){mount.innerHTML='';mount.removeAttribute('data-assist-kind');return}mount.dataset.assistKind=v.kind||'reminder';mount.classList.toggle('urgent',!!v.urgent);mount.classList.toggle('priority',v.kind==='priority');let source=MTGAssistMode.refLabel(v.reference),dismiss=v.attention==='convenience'?'':'';mount.innerHTML='
'+esc(v.title)+'
'+esc(v.attentionLabel)+''+esc(v.confidenceLabel)+'READ-ONLY
'+esc(v.detail)+'
SOURCE · '+esc(source)+'
'+(v.moreCount?'':'')+dismiss+'
';mount.querySelector('[data-assist-action]')?.addEventListener('click',()=>handleAssistAction(v.action,v));mount.querySelector('[data-assist-why]')?.addEventListener('click',()=>showAssistWhy(v));mount.querySelector('[data-assist-more]')?.addEventListener('click',()=>showAssistQueue(v));mount.querySelector('[data-assist-dismiss]')?.addEventListener('click',e=>{dismissAssistKey(e.currentTarget.dataset.assistDismiss);renderAssistCoach()})}

js.name: refreshContextHud
js.body:
function refreshContextHud(){if(typeof MTGPlayerHUD==='undefined'||!$('game'))return;let ctx=MTGPlayerHUD.context(st,me),base=hudFlags.contextualActions?MTGPlayerHUD.actionsFor(st,me):[{id:'cast',label:'CAST'},{id:'respond',label:'ACTION'},{id:'pass',label:'PASS'},{id:'more',label:'•••'}],priorityView=typeof MTGSmartPriority!=='undefined'?MTGSmartPriority.view(st,players,me):null,actions=typeof MTGSmartPriority!=='undefined'?MTGSmartPriority.controls(st,players,me,base):base,buttons=[$('cast'),$('resp'),$('pass'),$('more')];buttons.forEach((b,i)=>{let a=actions[i];if(!b)return;let blocked=!a||a.id==='wait';b.disabled=blocked;b.textContent=a?.label||'—';b.dataset.contextAction=a?.id||'';b.classList.toggle('dkPrimary',i===0&&!!a&&!blocked);b.classList.toggle('waitingAction',a?.id==='wait')});$('game').classList.toggle('hudModern',!!hudFlags.newPlayerHud);$('lifeMinus')?.classList.toggle('h',!hudFlags.universalNumeric);$('lifePlus')?.classList.toggle('h',!hudFlags.universalNumeric);let low=!!hudFlags.newPlayerHud&&!!hudFlags.lowAttention&&MTGPlayerHUD.lowAttention(st,me,{forcedAwake:hudForcedAwake()});$('game').classList.toggle('lowAttention',low);$('hudWakeBtn')?.classList.toggle('h',!low);let mode=ctx.stackActive?'stack':ctx.isActive?ctx.phaseGroup:'opponent',ph=$('contextHint'),hud=document.querySelector('.playerHud');if(hud)hud.dataset.context=mode;let director=typeof MTGSmartPriority!=='undefined'?MTGSmartPriority.director(st,players,me):null,mount=$('priorityDirector');if(mount&&director){mount.classList.toggle('h',!director.show);mount.classList.toggle('mine',!!director.isHolder);mount.classList.toggle('waiting',!!director.hasWindow&&!director.isHolder);let total=Math.max(0,director.passTotal||0),done=Math.max(0,director.passCount||0);mount.innerHTML=director.show?'
'+esc(director.title)+'
'+esc(director.mode.toUpperCase())+'
'+esc(director.detail)+'
'+(total?'
'+Array.from({length:total},(_,i)=>'').join('')+'
':''):''}if(ph){if(priorityView?.hasWindow)ph.textContent=priorityView.isHolder?'PRIORITY · YOUR DECISION':'PRIORITY · WAITING FOR P'+priorityView.holder;else if(ctx.stackActive)ph.textContent='STACK · '+ctx.stackSize+' OBJECT'+(ctx.stackSize===1?'':'S');else if(ctx.isActive)ph.textContent=ctx.phase.toUpperCase()+' · '+(priorityView?.mode==='full'?'PHASE CLEARED':'YOUR TURN');else ph.textContent=ctx.hasPriority?'YOU HAVE PRIORITY':'OPPONENT TURN · LOW ATTENTION READY'}renderAssistCoach()}
